question: Should Android automatically import and retire the v2-v8 combined database under the proposed cache/state ownership and gateway-removal recovery contract?
rationale: This is a large persisted-state and upgrade-boundary change; tests establish intended behavior, but acceptance of the automatic migration and recovery semantics needs an owner decision plus real-device or emulator evidence.

options.title: Accept with live upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the two-store design and require a redacted Android emulator/device run that upgrades a legacy database and demonstrates cache recovery and gateway removal.

options.title: Require narrower staged migration
options.body: Retain the current store split but defer legacy-file retirement or other irreversible cleanup until a later explicitly reviewed migration phase.

recommendation.title: Accept with live upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the two-store design and require a redacted Android emulator/device run that upgrades a legacy database and demonstrates cache recovery and gateway removal.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged Apple counterpart and this Android implementation, so they can explain the intended cross-platform storage contract.
